releases.headline: Linux desktop
releases.brief: Starlit for Linux x86_64. Native desktop integration.

highlights.title: Starlit for Linux x86_64
highlights.text: Download a Debian/Ubuntu .deb, Fedora/RPM .rpm, portable .AppImage or sandboxed .flatpak from the same release page as Windows, Android phones and Android TV.

highlights.title: Linux installers currently target x86_64 and are distributed as GitHub Release downloads, not through configured APT/DNF repositories or Flathub.
Native desktop integration
highlights.text: Linux packages use the Starlit launcher and desktop entry, with a separate Flatpak application ID to avoid replacing a Nuvio installation.

releases.headline: Android TV and Google TV
releases.summary: Android TV and Google TV · Cross-device reliability · Verification and limitations
releases.brief: Starlit on your television. More efficient large watch-progress synchronization.

highlights.title: Starlit on your television
highlights.text: A dedicated Android TV / Google TV application provides a Leanback launcher and large-screen Home, Search, Library and quick Settings, with D-pad focus and basic remote playback controls.

highlights.title: More efficient large watch-progress synchronization
highlights.text: Account progress snapshots are fetched in bounded pages with compatibility fallback for older servers, reducing the amount of data handled at once on large libraries.

highlights.title: Android Full and Play Store builds, optimized TV and debug APKs, iOS Kotlin, desktop diagnostics, native Unix checks and security checks passed on the merged feature.

releases.headline: Private reliability diagnostics
releases.summary: Private reliability diagnostics · Compatibility and limitations
releases.brief: Useful errors and warnings, only with consent. No browsing or viewing history in usage diagnostics.

highlights.title: Useful errors and warnings, only with consent
highlights.text: The optional Usage Statistics setting now covers fixed, anonymous technical signals for slow playback startup, torrent-engine errors, download retries, storage-quota pauses, playback failures and…

highlights.title: This version replaces an earlier tagged release candidate that did not publish after a desktop Settings UI test expected the previous diagnostics label.
No browsing or viewing history in usage diagnostics
highlights.text: Starlit stops reporting screen visits, player openings and download-list refreshes.

releases.headline: Phone-to-PC playback
releases.brief: Compare recommended sources on your phone. Fullscreen during stream preparation. Choose the PC's audio track remotely.

highlights.title: Compare recommended sources on your phone
highlights.text: The paired-PC source picker places the desktop's best match first, explains its ranking, and shows resolution-tier stars, reported seed/peer availability and cached status on alternatives.

highlights.title: Fullscreen during stream preparation
highlights.text: The desktop startup overlay now exposes fullscreen entry and exit before the player is ready, without hiding its close control or changing the torrent engine.

highlights.title: Choose the PC's audio track remotely
highlights.text: The phone controller can show and select tracks offered by the playing desktop session.

releases.headline: Anime franchise watch orders
releases.summary: Anime franchise watch orders · Phone-to-PC connectivity · Service reliability
releases.brief: Follow the story across seasons and films. Pair with wired computers over local Wi-Fi. Avoid repeated failed analytics submissions.

highlights.title: Follow the story across seasons and films
highlights.text: Anime detail pages can show a compact viewing-order preview and a full franchise list.

highlights.title: Pair with wired computers over local Wi-Fi
highlights.text: Restore reliable discovery, pairing and control when the phone is on Wi-Fi but the paired Windows PC uses Ethernet.

highlights.title: Avoid repeated failed analytics submissions
highlights.text: The independent account-security analytics exporter handles stale ingestion failures without rapid retry loops.
